'''Camp Three''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camp established by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. After taking control of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the Federation set up three camps on separate islands on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] near the base of a waterfall. The camps held civilians captured during the invasion. A [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield gate]] was built over the river on the side of the islands opposite the waterfall. Camp Three was on the island between [[Camp Two]] and the shield gate. The prisoners of Camp Three were freed by [[Rescue 1 (Naboo)|Rescue 1]] as part of the [[Raid on the Solleu River]]. Rescue 1 transported the civilians to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]'' which took them to a place safe from the Trade Federation.
